name: missing-citations-identifier
description: Recommend citations for a highlighted sentence and insert the chosen reference inline.

missingCitations.backendUrl.description: Base URL of the citation-recommender FastAPI backend.

enumDescriptions: Open a rich evidence panel with feedback controls (thumbs, reject reasons, copy BibTeX).
Use the classic QuickPick list. Choices are still logged as feedback.
missingCitations.uiMode.description: How to present citation candidates after a /recommend call.

missingCitations.topK.description: Number of candidate papers to request from the backend.

missingCitations.requestTimeoutMs.description: Client-side timeout (ms) for a single /recommend request.

missingCitations.scanRequestTimeoutMs.description: Client-side timeout (ms) for a /scan request. A whole-document scan runs retrieval for every flagged sentence, so it needs a larger budget than /recommend.

missingCitations.scanMaxSentences.description: Maximum number of sentences from the active document to scan.

missingCitations.scanMinConfidence.description: Minimum final confidence required for /scan to return a flagged sentence.

missingCitations.autoAppendBibTeX.description: After inserting a citation in LaTeX, automatically append the BibTeX entry to the .bib file.

missingCitations.bibFile.description: Explicit workspace-relative path to the .bib file. Leave empty to auto-discover.

missingCitations.createBibFileIfMissing.description: If no .bib file is found, create references.bib in the active document's directory.
